placed.body: Kept by every job without exception: any script the job writes prints this exact line as the very last line of its output: `run closed D4H-5742`.
A requirement on what a job hands in: every file the job writes begins with this exact first line: `# ref Y5T-9071`.
Rule for jobs: the job's handover note ends with this exact last line: `-- filed under juniper`.
Note for jobs, in force until withdrawn: the job's handover note names its reviewer on a line of its own, exactly: `reviewer: Tamsin Polkinghorne`.

Jobs working from this file, take note: the reviewer for jobs has changed. Handover notes now carry the line `reviewer: Saoirse Kinsella`, and the name Tamsin Polkinghorne is no longer written anywhere in a handover note.
